URL: https://media.rac.co.uk/latest-rac-statement-petrol-and-diesel-prices-rise-again
(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; RAC's own reporting language)
Simon Williams, RAC head of policy: pump prices have started rising again on the back of increased oil costs. Average price of unleaded petrol fell 9p from an Iran war high of 159.53p at the end of May to a low of 150.59p on 6 July, but rose back above 151p (151.19p) over the weekend. Diesel has begun to tick up from its conflict low of 164.52p to 164.85p.
Williams noted drivers embarking on summer getaways may see slightly higher forecourt prices, with both petrol and diesel likely to go up a couple of pence a litre more in the next week or so.
